Fashion Brand Operations Associate Job at Tango Fashions




        
    

        
        Tango Fashions is a  Start Up fashion brand and fashion consultancy focused on high end women's clothes. Main operations in Surulere Lagos.

We are recruiting to fill the position below:

Job Position: Fashion Brand Operations Associate
Job Location: Lagos
Employment Type: Full-time

Description


	This is an Exciting & Dynamic hands on field support role for a fashion brand involving errands, deliveries, collections in the Ikoyi / Obalende / Iponri Axis.


Duties
     

        



     (adsbygoogle = window.adsbygoogle || []).push({});
    
    




	Distribution and collection of fabrics to/from tailors and production partners
	Communication of clear instructions to production partners
	Following up on orders and tasks
	Taking pictures to record tasks
	Delivering messages
	Conducting Quality Control Checks
	Picking up finished garments and arranging delivery
	Purchasing/collecting fabrics, trimmings and other materials
	Other business errands as required using public transport


Requirements
Ideal candiate must be:


	Candidates should possess an OND, HND, or Bachelor's Degree with 1 year of experience.
	Smart, diligent and organised
	Able to follow instructions
	Have good written and verbal communication skills.
	Able to commute to either Obalende or Iponri
	Living in Lagos
	Basic tailoring skills.


Salary
N139,000 - N205,000 per month.

Method of Application 
Interested and qualified candidates should send their CV, Cover Letter and recent photo, indicating where in Lagos you live and why you want to work with us to "Mr OPE", via: [email protected] using the Job Position as the subject of the email.
